By Rosa Bellini · Prep 15 min · Bake 45 min

![Sliced lemon cake](https://kitchen.example.net/images/cake.jpg)

## Ingredients

- 3 eggs
- 200 g sugar
- 120 ml olive oil
- zest of 2 lemons
- 220 g flour

## Method

1. Whisk eggs and sugar until pale.
2. Fold in oil, zest and flour.
3. Bake at 170°C for 45 minutes.

Tip: the cake tastes better the next day.
